Container.Name: ipmi-dashboard
Container.Overview: Multi-server Supermicro BMC (IPMI) dashboard. Live sensor grid (temps + fans), 6h history charts, threshold alerts with auto-clear, fan control with hysteresis (no churning), power on/off/cycle/reset, System Event Log viewer. Webhook notifications (Discord/Slack/ntfy/generic). Talks IPMI v2 LAN+ via ipmitool. One server via env vars or many via servers.yaml. X10/X11 boards (X10SRi auto-detected).
Container.Changes:
### v2.0.2 - Unraid managed-app template (no more 3rd Party badge) - Multi-arch image (amd64+arm64) auto-published to GHCR
### v2.0.1 - X10SRi fan control auto-fallback (X11 cmd first, X10 legacy backup) - Manual fan changes now logged alongside auto curve adjustments - Webhook notifications: alert.opened/updated/cleared, power.action/failed
### v2.0.0 - Full rewrite as Flask web UI - Multi-server, 6h history charts, alert lifecycle, fan curve hysteresis

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on

Config.Name: Unraid disks.ini (optional)
Config.Description: Mount Unraid's live disk-state file to enable disk monitoring (set DISKS_ENABLED=1 below). Leave default; works on any Unraid host.

Config.Name: IPMI_BOARD
Config.Description: Board generation: X11 (default, also handles X10SRi) or X10_LEGACY for old X9/X10

Config.Name: WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Internal port (leave 8080 unless you know why)

Config.Name: HISTORY_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Auto-prune sensor history older than this

Config.Name: DISKS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable disk monitoring (Unraid). Set to 1 to turn on; uses the disks.ini path mount above.

Config.Name: DISKS_SOURCE
Config.Description: Disk source: local (read mounted disks.ini) or ssh (cat from a remote Unraid host)

Config.Name: NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional webhook URL for alert notifications (Discord/Slack/ntfy/custom)

Config.Name: NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_FORMAT
Config.Description: Webhook format: generic | discord | slack | ntfy
